verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's official documentation has dedicated installation topics for creating a bootable USB stick and installing Ubuntu Desktop, plus step-by-step installation tutorials. The marketing site also says it can be installed in place of Windows or alongside it. missing for 10: evidence of the guides' actual content (USB-writing tool, steps, boot-from-USB procedure), independent or hands-on corroboration of the USB install experience.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can create bootable installation media and install the OS from a USB stick

citations.quote: Installation: Create a bootable USB stick • Install Ubuntu Desktop
Tutorials take you step-by-step through installing Ubuntu Desktop and exploring the user interface.
Download Ubuntu Desktop and replace your current operating system. It's easy to install in place of Windows, or run Ubuntu alongside it.
